name: lasso-memory
description: Translate durable facts between Codex homes and audit Claude Code and Grok memory stores without sharing a mutable store.

interface.shortDescription: Move durable facts between agent memory stores.
interface.longDescription: Parses the Codex memory compilation artifact deterministically, uses DeepSeek V4 Flash only for durability and scope judgment, and emits reviewable fact files or Codex ad-hoc notes. memory-sync propagates additions, edits, and retirements only between compatible Codex homes while auditing Claude Code and Grok stores read-only; memory-tidy consolidates Codex facts on top of a synced state. Freshness, supersession, and deduplication stay in code; no runtime memory store is shared or written in place.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $memory-sync to extract durable facts from Codex memory and review them before they reach another runtime.
